hyperedges.label: Modules of the Núcleo personal OS

nodes.label: lib/data.ts
nodes.rationale: Data layer with demo fallback so the app runs with no configuration.

nodes.label: proxy.ts
nodes.rationale: Route protection + session refresh for protected app routes.

nodes.label: AI_PROVIDER
nodes.rationale: Env var selecting the AI provider (openai | google) for the Vercel AI SDK.

nodes.label: Estudios Module
nodes.rationale: Automatic import of subjects, assignments and exams from the Google Classroom API; study hour distribution handled by the Secretary.

nodes.label: Google Classroom API
nodes.rationale: Read-only scopes used: classroom.courses.readonly and classroom.coursework.me.readonly.

nodes.label: localStorage
nodes.rationale: Local-first design: the app works fully with no API keys; all data persists in the browser's localStorage, starts empty, and survives across sessions on that device.

nodes.label: Núcleo
nodes.rationale: PWA that acts as a personal Operating System with an AI Secretary; centralizes academic, sport and finance life and generates a prioritized daily plan from the user's real context.

nodes.label: Plan del Día
nodes.rationale: Structured, prioritized daily plan generated from the user's real context (pending tasks, today's routines, available budget) plus a conversational streaming chat.

nodes.label: PWA
nodes.rationale: Installable PWA via web manifest (display: standalone), icon.svg app icon, Geist font from next/font.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL + Auth (Google login) backend; RLS policies and triggers defined in supabase/migrations/00001_init.sql.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes — APIs, conventions, and file structure differ from training data — so agents must read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing any code; the block is written/re-added by next dev.
